policy: V5 preserves all earlier generations and promotes a separately evidenced revenue-recognition/accounting chain. A settled payment alone remains insufficient for external revenue recognition.

lineage_notes.reason: V2 separates project evidence from delivery evidence and binds exact payer, revenue destination, invoice ceiling and accounting-policy evidence.

supersessions.reason: V4 inserts explicit RevenueRecognition v2 and LedgerEvent v1 phases before FinancialSnapshot and moves latest trust reference to CommitmentEnvelope v3.
V3 commits an explicit immutable schema-policy profile and enforces latest-by-default creation.

additions.authority_note: Financial OS pre-ledger accounting decision. Requires SettlementReceipt v2 lineage plus external counterparty, contract, invoice, delivery/performance, dispute/refund, tax and FX policy evidence. AI cannot recognize revenue and the decision cannot post the ledger itself.
Provenance graph including explicit revenue recognition and ledger event. It references recognized accounting but does not itself create postings or execute transactions.
Typed exact-byte commitment with explicit schema-policy generation; no financial approval, settlement or accounting authority.
